Container.Name: momentarr
Container.Overview: Caching, serialising proxy for FlareSolverr-compatible Cloudflare solvers. Point Prowlarr/Jackett at momentarr instead of the solver: repeat requests to a solved site are served from the cached cf_clearance cookie over plain HTTP (~0.1s, no browser), and solves run one at a time so browsers never stack. Needs a solver alongside it: install Byparr or FlareSolverr and set Backend URL to it. Both must share the same outgoing IP (same host, or both behind the same VPN container).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: FlareSolverr API port. Use http://[IP]:8191/ as the FlareSolverr proxy host in Prowlarr.

Config.Name: Backend URL
Config.Description: URL of the real solver (Byparr or FlareSolverr).

Config.Name: Backend concurrency
Config.Description: Solves in flight at once. 1 keeps a single browser.

Config.Name: Cookie TTL (hours)
Config.Description: Upper bound for cached clearances; the cookie's own expiry wins if sooner.
